description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to deep copying (cloning) of objects within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes providers for deep copiers, marker interfaces, implementations for shallow and deep copying, context management for copying operations, and utility classes.

classes.name: ShallowCopier
classes.description: Provides functionality for shallow copying of objects, assuming they are shallow-copyable.

classes.name: ShallowCopier<T>
classes.description: Generic class for shallow copying of type T, returning the input instance directly.

classes.name: CopyContext
classes.description: Encapsulates the context for a deep copy operation, including cache of previous copies, and methods to perform deep copying.

classes.name: CopyContextPool
classes.description: Object pool managing reusable instances of CopyContext for efficient copying operations.

methods.name: GetDeepCopier
methods.description: Retrieves a deep copier instance capable of copying objects of a specified type.

methods.name: TryGetDeepCopier
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a deep copier for a specified type, returning null if unavailable.

methods.name: GetBaseCopier
methods.description: Gets a base type copier for a specified class type.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a provided object using a given context.

methods.name: RecordCopy
methods.description: Records a copy of an original object to avoid duplicate copying.
